name: Camping am See International
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Camping am See International is located in the municipality of Buxheim in Tirol, in the district of Imst. The site offers pitches for caravans, motorhomes and tents. The sanitary facilities are modern and designed to be accessible for people with disabilities. A swimming lake is located on the grounds. A playground is available for children. The surrounding area is suitable for hiking and cycling tours. A small shop provides guests with the essentials.
